Travelled a short distance before reattaching to the field. Rounding the h/t he advised that he endeavoured to direct his mount out to obtain clear running. When queried regarding not obtaining a run to the inside of a rnr when that rnr began to shift out, rdr stated that he had already pursued to direct his mount to the o/side of that rnr&continued out to obtain clear running.Shortly after the W/P, blundered, both mount&rdr fell. Post Vet no abs. Tnr advised V/C required.
